findings.title: Production lifecycle state is also decoded as test-unlocked, enabling debug and DFT controls
findings.location: p_lc_signal_decode, overlapping LcStProd case items around lines 116-154
findings.description: The operational-state `unique case (lc_state_i)` includes `LcStProd` in two case items. The first occurrence groups it with `LcStTestUnlocked0` through `LcStTestUnlocked6` and asserts `lc_raw_test_rma`, `lc_dft_en`, `lc_nvm_debug_en`, `lc_hw_debug_en`, `lc_cpu_en`, and `lc_iso_part_sw_wr_en`, while selecting `RndCnstLcKeymgrDivTestUnlocked`. The later occurrence groups `LcStProd` with `LcStProdEnd` and implements the intended production policy. This is not merely a simulation X issue: if the RTL is accepted, ordinary SystemVerilog case execution selects the first matching item, while synthesis handling of the `unique` overlap may additionally permit tool-dependent optimization. Consequently, a device whose valid OTP lifecycle state is PROD can synthesize with manufacturing/debug capabilities enabled and production key-manager controls disabled. The affected controls are registered by `prim_lc_sender` and leave `lc_ctrl` without a top-level policy override. Strict downstream interpretation of the valid `On` encoding does not mitigate the issue because the decoder deliberately emits valid enabled encodings. This can expose hardware debug and NVM debug access in production, violate key and lifecycle isolation, and cause availability failures through the test diversification value and disabled production key-manager path. A lint warning or runtime unique-case diagnostic is not a hardware mitigation.
findings.recommendation: Remove `LcStProd` from the test-unlocked case item so that it appears only in the production branch with `LcStProdEnd`. Treat duplicate or overlapping lifecycle decode items as synthesis-blocking errors. Add elaboration/formal checks proving that every legal `lc_state_e` value matches exactly one policy branch, and specifically assert in PROD that `lc_dft_en_o`, `lc_nvm_debug_en_o`, `lc_hw_debug_en_o`, and `lc_raw_test_rma_o` are `Off`, `lc_keymgr_en_o` is `On`, and `lc_keymgr_div_o` equals the production diversification constant.
